'''Til''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] and [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] known as "Crunch." He was a hacker and information gatherer with considerable skill. He had a disturbing appetite for organs from mutated [[fefze beetle]]s found on [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. Til's main occupation was to monitor the lively criminal activities in the [[Duro system/Legends|Duro system]] for the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clan.<ref name="CatCW" />
